card.name: Column dividers inside flattened tables
card.fires_on: The vertical-bar column separator (often a double bar) between cells of a plain-text table, usually after a short cell value such as a number, yes/no or a name.

modes.label: Divider between data cells
modes.description: The separator falls after a value like yes, no, a number or a distance, before the next cell in the row.

modes.label: Divider after a header cell
modes.description: The separator falls after a column heading in a table's first row.

card.plain: It fires on the bar character that separates columns when a table has been flattened into plain text.
